name: @samvardiq/clinic-cms-connector
description: Governed connector to the Clinic CMS external API (CLINIC-W1B-2). Owns the CMS-specific HTTP/HMAC client, normalized DTOs, response validation, error normalization, and the organization-scoped connection configuration this connector reads. Does not own Samvardiq authentication, membership, TrustedOrganizationContext creation, or any frontend/clinical logic.
